## What kind of system this is

**eShop is a .NET Aspire–orchestrated microservices reference application** (an e‑commerce shop), not a library — the analyzer classifies the solution `eShop.slnx` as archetype "App", style "Microservices" with high confidence, on the evidence of "Aspire orchestration of 9 runnable services" across 19 projects. Stack: .NET 10, Minimal APIs + MVC controllers, gRPC, MediatR/CQRS with DDD aggregates (`Buyer`, `Order`), EF Core, FluentValidation, RabbitMQ event bus, Blazor and .NET MAUI front ends.

## The composition root

`src/eShop.AppHost` is the Aspire AppHost (`Aspire AppHost` style, `Aspire` stack). Its `Program.cs` is what composes the running system; each service is added there:

- Identity.API — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:23`
- Basket.API — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:30`
- Catalog.API — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:36`
- Ordering.API — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:40`
- OrderProcessor — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:46`
- PaymentProcessor — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:51`
- Webhooks.API — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:54`
- WebhookClient — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:65`
- WebApp — `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:69`

Those nine are the processes that start when you run the solution (F5 on the AppHost). Cross-wiring is also done there: Basket/Ordering/Webhooks/WebhookClient/WebApp all reference Identity.API (`src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:30`, `:40`, `:54`, `:65`, `:69`), and Identity.API is given back-references to Basket.API, Ordering.API, WebApp, Webhooks.API and WebhookClient at `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs:97`. The AppHost also injects forwarded-headers config into every project (`src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:17`), and every service shares `eShop.ServiceDefaults` (OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery).

## What each process is, and its entry points

| Process | Kind | Entry points |
|---|---|---|
| **WebApp** | Blazor Server + YARP storefront | UI routes `GET /` , `/cart` (`src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Cart/CartPage.razor:1`), `/checkout` (`src/WebApp/Components/Pages/Checkout/Checkout.razor:1`), `/user/orders` (`src/WebApp/Components/Pages/User/Orders.razor:1`), `/user/login`; plus 3 bus consumers for order status (`src/WebApp/Services/OrderStatus/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToSubmittedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:5`) |
| **Catalog.API** | Minimal-API Web API + EF Core/pgvector | HTTP endpoints in `src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:21`–`:107` (items CRUD, brands/types, semantic search at `:53`); consumes `OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidation` (`src/Catalog.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToAwaitingValidationIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3`) and `...ToPaid` |
| **Basket.API** | gRPC service backed by Redis | `Basket.GetBasket` / `UpdateBasket` / `DeleteBasket` (`src/Basket.API/Grpc/BasketService.cs:8`); consumes `OrderStartedIntegrationEvent` (`src/Basket.API/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStartedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:6`) |
| **Ordering.API** | Web API, DDD + MediatR CQRS | `POST /api/orders/`, `PUT /api/orders/cancel`, `PUT /api/orders/ship`, `POST /api/orders/draft`, `GET /api/orders/...`; 5 bus consumers (`src/Ordering.API/Application/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3` and siblings) and 7 domain-event handlers (`src/Ordering.API/Application/DomainEventHandlers/`). Every command passes `LoggingBehavior → TransactionBehavior → ValidatorBehavior` |
| **Identity.API** | Duende IdentityServer + ASP.NET Identity | MVC controllers `Account`, `Consent`, `Device`, `External`, `Grants` (`src/Identity.API/Quickstart/Account/AccountController.cs:39`, `.../Consent/ConsentController.cs:32`, `.../Device/DeviceController.cs:27`, `.../Grants/GrantsController.cs:32`) |
| **OrderProcessor** | Worker service | Single hosted service `GracePeriodManagerService`, registered at `src/OrderProcessor/Extensions/Extensions.cs:18`, publishes `GracePeriodConfirmedIntegrationEvent` (`src/OrderProcessor/Services/GracePeriodManagerService.cs:55`) |
| **PaymentProcessor** | Worker service | Bus-only: `OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler` (`src/PaymentProcessor/IntegrationEvents/EventHandling/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3`) |
| **Webhooks.API** | Web API + EF Core | `POST/GET/DELETE /api/webhooks` (`src/Webhooks.API/Apis/WebHooksApi.cs:66`); consumes `ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent` (`src/Webhooks.API/IntegrationEvents/ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEventHandler.cs:3`) |
| **WebhookClient** | Blazor demo subscriber | UI `GET /`, `/add-webhook` (`src/WebhookClient/Components/Pages/AddWebhook.razor:1`), `/login`; HTTP `POST /webhook-received`, `POST /logout` |

Totals across the graph: 109 entry points — 43 HTTP endpoints, 42 UI entries, 13 message consumers, 7 domain-event handlers, 3 gRPC methods, 1 hosted service.

## Not started by the AppHost

**ClientApp** (.NET MAUI, MVVM with `[RelayCommand]` view models, e.g. `src/ClientApp/ViewModels/CheckoutViewModel.cs:104`) and **HybridApp** (MAUI + Blazor WebView, `src/HybridApp/Components/Pages/Catalog/Catalog.razor:1`) are runnable apps but are **not** referenced by `eShop.AppHost` — its dependency list is exactly the nine services above. They are launched separately (ClientApp even has its own solution, `src/ClientApp/ClientApp.sln`). The remaining projects — `EventBus`, `EventBusRabbitMQ`, `IntegrationEventLogEF`, `Ordering.Domain`, `Ordering.Infrastructure`, `WebAppComponents`, `eShop.ServiceDefaults` — are libraries with no entry point of their own.

## How the processes talk

- Sync: WebApp → Basket.API over gRPC (`src/WebApp/Services/BasketService.cs:7` → `src/Basket.API/Grpc/BasketService.cs:8`); WebApp → Catalog.API and Ordering.API over HTTP (`src/WebApp/Extensions/Extensions.cs:34`, `:38`); WebhookClient → Webhooks.API (`src/WebhookClient/Extensions/Extensions.cs:19`).
- Async: 13 integration events over the RabbitMQ event bus, e.g. Ordering.API → Basket.API `OrderStartedIntegrationEvent` (`src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:32`), Ordering.API → PaymentProcessor (`src/Ordering.API/Application/DomainEventHandlers/OrderStatusChangedToStockConfirmedDomainEventHandler.cs:30`), Catalog.API → Webhooks.API (`src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs:350`).

## Caveats

I could not open `src/eShop.AppHost/Program.cs` directly with my tools (the file has no indexed symbol), so the backing infrastructure resources the AppHost provisions are an **inference**, not something I read: the package set includes `Aspire.Hosting.PostgreSQL`, `Aspire.Hosting.Redis`, `Aspire.Hosting.RabbitMQ`, `Aspire.Hosting.Yarp`, `Aspire.Hosting.Azure.CognitiveServices` and `CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Ollama`, and the AI-model selection enum in `src/eShop.AppHost/Extensions.cs:12` lists `AzureOpenAI`/`AzureOpenAIExisting` variants — consistent with Postgres, Redis, RabbitMQ containers plus an optional OpenAI/Ollama resource, but you should read that file to confirm exact resource names and counts. Also note the analysis covered only `eShop.slnx`; two other solutions exist in the repo (`src/ClientApp/ClientApp.sln`, `tests/ClientApp.UnitTests/ClientApp.UnitTests.sln`), so test projects are outside what I inspected.
